promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-07-31 (nyiso-108) BY EXPLICIT OWNER OVERRIDE of this session's own pre-registration. NYISO keeper -> 2026-07-31-nyiso108-hydro-input-repair (bundle results/calibration/nyiso108_hydrorepair_B). DETERMINATION REGRESSES: CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (8 target-grade / 1 ledgered / 0 FAILs) -> NOT-YET (7 target-grade / 1 ledgered / 1 FAIL), the FAIL being C3a mean LMP 2023 at +10.2 % against a +/-10.0 % band — a 0.2 pp breach, from a control that sat at +8.6 %. PREREG-nyiso108-hydro-input-repair-2026-07-31.md §6 pre-committed that a new FAIL means NOT-YET and NO promotion; the owner overrode that in-session ('If structural integrity improves but gates regress that may still be a keeper'), so this promotion is recorded as an override, not as the prereg's own verdict. ONE delta vs the nyiso-105 keeper: the hydro INPUT REPAIR, hydro_backfill_year=2024 + hydro_eia930_monthly=true. It adds ZERO free parameters (+1 DOF ledger entry, +0 residual-identified): both are pre-existing registered measured-data switches ALREADY ARMED ON FOUR OF THE SIX KEEPERS (CAISO/PJM/MISO/NEISO), the level is read from EIA-930 NYIS NG: WAT and the backfill year is the prior COMPLETE EIA-923 vintage. Nothing is chosen; nothing is fitted. WHAT IT FIXES: NYISO was the SOLE material-hydro ISO whose keeper ran on an unrepaired truncated EIA-923 early release — the nyiso-105 keeper's 2025 LP hydro fleet was THREE PLANTS / 21.0482 TWh against 147 / 27.8750 in 2024 (2.0 % plant retention, max MW 4,587 -> 3,343), while the scorer's 2025 benchmark was already repaired to EIA-930 24.1039. The arm restores 147 units and 24.0589 TWh. CONSTRUCTION ADJUDICATED PRE-SOLVE against NYISO MIS P-63 Real-Time Fuel Mix, the one series that is NEITHER the model input NOR the scorer benchmark: the pinned level lands -1.29/-0.88/-0.78 % from P-63 in 2023/2024/2025, against the bare vintage's +4.48/+3.33/-13.20 % and the backfill-only alternative's +4.49/+3.33/+7.20 %. Backfill-only (the PJM/MISO posture) was REFUSED on shape as well as level — it DEGRADES the 2025 seasonal shape below the keeper (P-63 shape r 0.9251 -> 0.8265) and puts the annual peak in March against P-63's May, because it carries 2024's freshet forward. The PJM/MISO pin refusal does NOT transfer: it exists for a pumped-storage fold NYISO does not have (NYIS NG: WAT / 923 HY = 0.9448/0.9606, BELOW 923 HY, and NYIS PS netgen is net NEGATIVE, so pumping is netted IN, not folded in gross — re-confirmed independently at nyiso-107). EVERY PRE-REGISTERED CONSTRUCTION GATE PASSES. K2 passes on the STRICT BYTE basis: the same-HEAD control reproduces the committed nyiso-105 keeper at EXACTLY 0.0 MW on every class in all three years, so there is NO same-HEAD drift and the A/B is unconfounded. K3 liveness: hydro moves -1.5505/-1.0904/+3.0107 TWh. K4: the recorded configs differ in exactly the two hydro keys. K5: both bundles [2023, 2024, 2025] — the holdout spend freeze is ACTIVE and untouched. THE HYDRO VOLUME NUMBER IS DECLARED PLUMBING AND IS NOT BANKED (prereg §3.2): pinning the budget to the same EIA-930 series the 2025 benchmark uses drives 2025 hydro to -0.19 % BY CONSTRUCTION. This is not a new concession — the codebase ALREADY classifies hydro as a D-10 pinned class ('L6 hydro (monthly budgets)'), and C1 scores only the gas/coal families, so hydro volume is not a gated C1 row at all. The scored movement is FOSSIL DISPLACEMENT, which is free, and it is exactly 1:1 with hydro (2023 -1.55/+1.57, 2024 -1.09/+1.11, 2025 +3.01/-3.23 TWh across CC_REGULAR, ST_GAS, CT_PEAKER, oil). WHAT DOES NOT MOVE: C1 stays 14/14 all-class and 10/10 free-class in BOTH arms. C2/C3b/C4/C6/C7/C8 all PASS in both. C3c is BIT-IDENTICAL — model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300 in both arms — so this arm does NOT touch the C3c frontier, spends no new caveat slot, and the C3c ledger entry carries forward unchanged. THE ONE REGRESSION, REPORTED AND NOT PATCHED (rules 1 [R-STRUCT] / 14 [R-ACCURATE]): C3a 2023 +8.6 % -> +10.2 %, crossing the +/-10 % band. This is a DISCOVERED defect, not a created one. EIA-923 raw 2023 (28.0312 TWh) sits +3.11 % ABOVE NYISO's own P-63 telemetry and the arm's level sits -1.29 % below it, so the keeper was carrying ~1.55 TWh of PHANTOM zero-MC 2023 hydro that was SUPPRESSING A REAL 2023 OVER-PRICING; removing it exposes the miss. Rule 14 is explicit that the accurate input stays and the root cause gets found rather than buried, and reverting the measured input to restore the PASS is exactly what it forbids. Identical signature to PJM at pjm-143 ('C3a 2023 now +2.99 %, was +2.05: the phantom energy was suppressing a real over-pricing'), which was likewise promoted on rule-1 structural fidelity. NAMED SUCCESSOR (nyiso-109): the NYISO 2023 fossil over-pricing now visible at +10.2 % — an offer-stack / fuel-basis root cause, NOT the hydro input. Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-nyiso108-hydro-input-repair-2026-07-31.md, results/calibration/PREREG-nyiso108-hydro-input-repair-2026-07-31.md, results/calibration/_nyiso108_hydro_input_repair_ab.json, results/calibration/_nyiso108_hydro_construction_audit.json.

frontier.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
frontier.amendment_note: THE C3c FRONTIER DECLARATION ITSELF STANDS — it is scoped to the C3c scarcity-tail lever queue, and nyiso-108 measured C3c BIT-IDENTICAL (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h in both the arm and its same-HEAD control), so no C3c evidence changed and the exhausted-queue finding is untouched. WHAT DOES CHANGE IS THE POSTURE THE DECLARATION IMPLIED. The nyiso-104b frontier was granted on the premise that C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; that premise no longer holds. nyiso-108's hydro input repair (a rule-14 correction with zero free parameters) removed ~1.55 TWh of phantom 2023 hydro and EXPOSED a pre-existing NYISO 2023 fossil over-pricing, which now FAILs C3a at +10.2 % against a +/-10 % band. NYISO's determination is therefore NOT-YET, not CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, and the blocker is a NEW, NON-C3c, TRACTABLE defect with a named successor lane (nyiso-109: the 2023 offer-stack / fuel-basis root cause). NYISO IS NO LONGER AT A FRONTIER IN THE SENSE OF 'options exhausted' — it is back in active calibration with a concrete open item. The C3c re-open condition (Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G topology split, owner charter required) is unchanged. HOLDOUT UNAFFECTED: NYISO keeps `complete` (validation tier) and stays ABSENT from `final`; the ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve.
